howto.what: 这个技能会自动复制Telegram适配器文件、注册适配器，并安装依赖。然后引导你通过BotFather创建Telegram机器人、获取令牌，并完成配对，从而将Telegram频道连接到你的NanoClaw系统。
howto.when: 当你在NanoClaw设置流程中（如执行`/setup`或`/init-first-agent`命令）并选择添加Telegram频道时触发。

say.note: 技能开始复制文件并注册适配器。

say.text: 帮我创建一个Telegram机器人并配对。
say.note: 引导你操作BotFather并完成配对流程。

howto.what_en: This skill automatically copies Telegram adapter files, registers the adapter, and installs dependencies. It then guides you through creating a Telegram bot via BotFather, obtaining a token, and completing a pairing handshake to connect Telegram channels to your NanoClaw system.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are in the NanoClaw setup flow (e.g., running `/setup` or `/init-first-agent`) and choose to add a Telegram channel.

say_en.note: The skill begins copying files and registering the adapter.

say_en.text: Help me create a Telegram bot and pair it.
say_en.note: Guides you through BotFather and the pairing process.
